texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the Inventory module
texts.Categories:Subtitle: Organize products into groups.
texts.Suppliers:Subtitle: Vendors and their contact details.
texts.Products:Subtitle: Catalogue, pricing and stock.
texts.Categories:DeleteConfirm: Delete “{0}”? Products in this category keep working — they just lose this grouping.
texts.Suppliers:DeleteConfirm: Delete “{0}”? Existing purchase orders keep their history, but you can no longer create new orders from this supplier.
texts.Products:DeleteConfirm: Delete “{0}”? Its past sales and history stay in the reports, but you can no longer sell it or add stock of it.
texts.Name: Name
texts.Products:ImageNotImage: That file isn't an image. Choose a JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF photo.
texts.Products:ImageTooLarge: The photo is too large — it must be 3 MB or smaller.
texts.Products:ImageBadFormat: Supported image formats are JPG, PNG, WEBP and GIF.
texts.Branches:Subtitle: Store locations and their managers.
texts.Branches:DeleteConfirm: Delete “{0}”? This hides the branch and its stock from daily work. Its past records stay in the reports.
texts.IsSellableHint: Can be sold at the POS / on sales.
texts.IsPurchasableHint: Can be bought from a supplier.
texts.SelectBranchPrompt: Select a branch to view its stock
texts.InitialStockAtBranchesHint: Enter how many units each branch starts with. Leave 0 to skip a branch — you can always add stock later from the Stock page.
texts.InitialStockPartialFail: The product was created, but stock could not be added at: {0}. Add it from the Stock page.
texts.WriteOffExpiredConfirm: Remove all {0} expired unit(s) of {1} from stock? This records a write-off and cannot be undone.
texts.ProductionDateHint: For perishable products: the expiry date of the added stock is calculated from this date + the product's shelf life.
texts.ProductStock:Title: Stock across branches
texts.ProductStock:NoStock: This product isn't stocked at any branch yet.
texts.NoBranchAccess: You don't have access to any branch.
texts.Inventory:BranchInventory:Duplicate: This product is already in the selected branch's inventory.
texts.Inventory:BranchInventory:BranchAccessDe: You don't have access to this branch.
texts.Inventory:BranchInventory:InvalidStockLi: Maximum stock ({MaximumStock}) must be greater than or equal to minimum stock ({MinimumStock}).
texts.Inventory:BranchInventory:NoExpiredStock: There is no expired stock to write off for this product.
texts.Inventory:BranchInventory:Concurrency: Stock was modified by another user. Please reload and try again.
texts.Inventory:BranchInventory:PerishableBatc: This quantity cannot be issued because part of it is not backed by a usable expiry batch. Review the batches and expiry dates first.
texts.AuditLogSubtitle: Immutable history of every stock change
texts.ShelfLifeHint: Leave empty for non-perishable products (no expiry tracking).
texts.StockBatchesSubtitle: Best-effort expiry ledger of received lots — FEFO consumption, freshest last.
texts.WasteAnalytics:Subtitle: Where expired stock dies: write-off cost by branch, product and week.
texts.WasteAnalytics:NoData: No write-offs recorded in this window. Expired stock written off through the decision log will show up here.
texts.WasteAnalytics:WasteByBranchSub: Write-off cost per branch in the selected window.
texts.WasteAnalytics:WasteOverTimeSub: Weekly write-off cost — watch for spikes after over-ordering.
texts.WasteAnalytics:TopWastedProductsSub: Top 10 products by write-off cost in the window.
texts.Inventory:Products:DuplicateSku: A product with SKU '{SKU}' already exists. SKUs must be unique.
texts.Inventory:Products:InvalidShelfLifeDays: Shelf life must be between 1 and 3650 days (got {ShelfLifeDays}). Leave it empty for non-perishable products.
texts.Inventory:StockBatches:InvalidQuantity: A stock batch must be received with a positive quantity.
texts.Inventory:StockBatches:InvalidConsumeQua: Cannot consume {Quantity} from this batch — {QuantityRemaining} remaining.
texts.Inventory:Suppliers:InvalidLeadTime: Lead time must be between 0 and 365 days (got {LeadTimeDays}).
texts.Scorecard:Tooltip: Orders: {0} ({1} fully received) · On-time {2} · Fill {3} · Avg delay {4} · Measured lead {5}
texts.Stocktake:Title: Branch stocktake
texts.Stocktake:Subtitle: Count the shelf, review every variance, then update stock in one safe step.
texts.Stocktake:SelectBranch: Select a branch to start counting
texts.Stocktake:NoBranches: You do not have access to an active branch.
texts.Stocktake:ReasonRequiredInline: A reason is required for every difference.
texts.Stocktake:Empty: There are no active sellable products initialized at this branch.
texts.Stocktake:LoadFailed: The stocktake sheet could not be loaded.
texts.Stocktake:ReviewSubtitle: Only lines with a difference will change stock.
texts.Stocktake:SubmitSubtitle: Stock will not change now; the count will wait for manager approval.
texts.Stocktake:NotesHint: This note is saved on every stock movement created by this count.
texts.Stocktake:PerishableOverageHint: Check the preparation date entered for every extra perishable product.
texts.Stocktake:UnrecordedSaleHint: An unrecorded-sale reason corrects stock only; it does not create an invoice or add revenue.
texts.Stocktake:PostFailed: The stocktake was not posted. No stock was changed.
texts.Stocktake:Submitted: The stocktake was sent for review without changing stock.
texts.Stocktake:SubmitFailed: The stocktake could not be submitted. No stock was changed.
texts.Stocktake:Approved: The stocktake was approved and stock was updated.
texts.Stocktake:ApproveFailed: The stocktake could not be approved. Stock was not fully updated.
texts.Stocktake:Rejected: The stocktake was rejected without changing stock.
texts.Stocktake:RejectFailed: The stocktake could not be rejected.
texts.Stocktake:PendingReviewMessage: The count is read-only and stock has not changed. A manager can approve or reject it from the history details.
texts.Stocktake:DiscardMessage: Changing the branch or reloading will clear the counts entered on this sheet.
texts.Stocktake:AllCounted: All products are counted. Review the summary before posting.
texts.Stocktake:StartHint: A fixed stock snapshot will be saved. You can save your progress and resume later.
texts.Stocktake:NoActiveDraft: There is no open stocktake for this branch.
texts.Stocktake:DraftSaveFailed: The draft could not be saved.
texts.Stocktake:StartFailed: The stocktake could not be started.
texts.Stocktake:CancelSessionMessage: The saved draft will close without changing stock. It will remain visible in history.
texts.Stocktake:CancelSessionFailed: The stocktake session could not be cancelled.
texts.Stocktake:HistorySubtitle: Saved drafts and previously completed counts for this branch.
texts.Stocktake:ReviewNotesPlaceholder: Enter the rejection reason or approval note
texts.Stocktake:NoHistory: No stocktake sessions have been recorded for this branch yet.
texts.Stocktake:DetailsFailed: The stocktake details could not be loaded.
texts.Stocktake:HistoryLoadFailed: The stocktake history could not be loaded.
texts.Stocktake:UnsavedSwitchMessage: Changing the branch or reloading will discard only the changes not saved to this draft.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:Title: Sales and stocktake variance review
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:Subtitle: See which products have shortages or waste, then open each product to understand what needs follow-up.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:Explanation: The report uses non-voided invoices and only stocktakes approved by a manager within the selected period.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:ReasonSummarySub: These are the reasons selected for shortages or overages and later approved by a manager.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:ReasonLines: This reason appeared on {0} count lines
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:ProductCompariso: Open this table when you need to compare all products; the important actions are listed above.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:NoData: No sales or approved stocktakes were found in this period.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:LoadFailed: The reconciliation report could not be loaded.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:CostBasisHint: Note: loss values are estimates based on the product's current cost, not its cost on the stocktake date.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:AttentionSub: Start with these products. They are prioritized by unrecorded sales, waste, repeat differences, then shortage value.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:ShortageRate: Missing pieces as % of sold + missing
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:NoAttention: Great, no variances need action in this period.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:GuideTitle: How should I read this report?
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:GuideSubtitle: This is not a profit report. It highlights differences between recorded sales and the physical stocktake.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:GuideSales: It totals recorded sales for the period.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:GuideStocktake: It totals shortages and overages from approved stocktakes.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:GuideAction: It shows which products should be opened and reviewed first.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:WriteOffOverview: Pieces recorded as waste or damaged
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:ReportRuleTitle: What is included in the calculation?
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:UnrecordedAlertT: Some sales were not recorded as invoices
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:UnrecordedAlertM: A shortage of {0} pieces was explained as unrecorded sales. Stock was corrected, but no revenue was added; review the cashier invoices.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:IssueUnrecordedS: Shortage caused by an unrecorded sale
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:IssueRepeated: The difference occurred more than once
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:IssueUnrecordedS: {0} pieces were treated as sold without an invoice. Stock was corrected, but their revenue is missing from sales.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:IssueWriteOffDes: {0} pieces were recorded as waste or damaged. Review the reason and storage process to reduce recurrence.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:IssueRepeatedDes: This product had a difference in {0} approved stocktakes, so it needs more than a one-time recount.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:IssueShortageDes: The stocktake did not find {0} pieces that were recorded in the system. Review the product history and recount it.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:NextUnrecordedSa: Review cashier invoices and orders that may have been handed over without an invoice.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:NextWriteOff: Review the waste or damage reason, preparation date, and storage method.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:NextRepeated: Check display, storage, and handover steps because the difference repeated across stocktakes.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:NextRecount: Recount the product and make sure every sale or waste movement is recorded before the next stocktake.
texts.StocktakeReconciliation:SelectBranchForS: Select one branch at the top of the page to open the product's full timeline.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:Empty: The stocktake must contain at least one product.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:Incomplete: The stocktake does not match the branch's current sellable product list. Reload and count again.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:DuplicateLine: The same inventory product was submitted more than once.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:NotesRequired: Enter a short note describing this stocktake.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:NotesTooLong: The stocktake note cannot exceed 300 characters.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:FutureProductionDate: A preparation date cannot be in the future.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:ReasonRequired: Select a reason for every stocktake difference.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:InvalidReason: The selected reason does not match this shortage or overage.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:OtherReasonRequired: Explain the difference when selecting Other.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:ProductionDateRequir: Enter the preparation date for every extra perishable product.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:MovementNoteTooLong: The combined stocktake note and reason details are too long.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:SessionNotDraft: This stocktake session is already closed.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:SessionConcurrency: This draft was changed in another tab. Reload it before continuing.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:SessionLineMismatch: The saved draft lines do not match this stocktake session. Reload the draft.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:SessionNotPendingRev: This stocktake session is not waiting for review.
texts.Inventory:Stocktake:ReviewNotesRequired: Enter a clear reason when rejecting a stocktake.
